events.invalidation: The Canada-Japan relative-value case fails if CADJPY gives back the post-entry advance through 110.9 alongside a reversal in WTI 101.79 and/or Brent 108.79 and/or compression of the Canada-Japan 10Y gap (3.93 versus 2.927), or if BoJ/MoF yen action reprices JPY independently of the Canadian oil, carry, and hike-path differential. Additional technical levels: null.
events.rationale: The freeze still prints a Canada-versus-Japan gap that a dollar pair would smear. CADJPY is 112.54 on 20 Oct against a 110.9 entry, book mark about 112.44; WTI is 101.79 and Brent is 108.79; Canada Prima-pressure is rising with end-2027 Brent 16.58 above the July MPR 70 conditioning; CORRA is 2.26 versus March 2027 2.995; TONA is 1.227 with March 2027 TONA 1.6825; Canada 10Y is 3.93 versus Japan 10Y 2.927. That is still oil-exporter versus oil-importer, a 103bp cash-carry lead, and a BoC path that prices 73bp of tightening against 46bp in TONA, without feeding SOFR 3.88 or the 3.75-4.00 funds range through USDCAD or USDJPY. This seat reads remaining edge at the freeze: CADJPY is only the 28th one-year percentile and z -0.59, so 112.54 has not used up the cheapness that 110.9 bought, while the five-year 81st percentile is the longer-window caution, not a reason to switch expression. EURCAD at 1.5758 (2nd one-year percentile, one-month -2.07%) is CAD already having won versus the euro; chasing short EURCAD from here is a completed move, not a cleaner CA-EA differential. EURJPY at 177.34 (about the 6th one-year percentile, three-month -4.77%) is broad yen strength that CADJPY has already damped (three-month only -3.11%) because oil and carry offset Japan; long EURJPY would throw away that Canada leg. EURGBP at 0.8403 (0.2 one-year percentile) is a UK/BoE 3.75% 6-3 hold with three members preferring a hike, not an eligible US/CA/EA/JP cross and not a substitute for the CA-JP oil-policy stack. AONIA 4.60 versus CORRA 2.26 is the same known Australia-Canada cash wedge, not a new AU-versus-CA policy, growth, inflation, or carry shock, so the closed AUDCAD fade stays shut and no new Australia risk is opened. What the freeze does not show is the next BoJ/MoF yen action or whether crude stays bid; those sit in invalidation rather than in a new cross.
